description: Scheduled US macro events (FOMC + CPI + NFP + PCE) with dates and consensus. Consensus values are Mako-curated and arrive with provenance (source, source_url, published_at, age_days). An event with no curated consensus carries consensus: null, which means the value is not published rather than zero. Mode 1.2 covers the qualitative-scenario path for events whose consensus is not published. consensus_metrics_expected lists the metric keys a complete consensus would carry for that event type. Market-implied pricing (what_is_priced / CME FedWatch) is a separate quantity and remains deferred. COVERAGE: only fomc, cpi, nfp and pce have dates in this calendar. ecb, boj and boe are accepted for consistency with the consensus vocabulary but carry NO dates, so filtering to them returns an empty list and says so in staleness_flags — that is 'not tracked here', never 'none is scheduled'. Coverage also runs to a fixed last date; a window past it is flagged rather than silently short.

event_types.description: Filter by event types (default: fomc, cpi, nfp, pce). Only those four carry dates; ecb/boj/boe return empty with a staleness flag.

lookahead_days.description: How many days forward to look (default 14)

name: get_event_calendar
